For the checks after a deploy. Limited per IP.
Public. A revoked, expired or unknown link answers 410 INVITATION_INVALID; an accepted one answers with status accepted.

post.summary: U5 Sign up through an invitation
post.description: Public, limited per IP with the sign-in paths. Creates the account for the invitation's address and answers signed in. An invitation to a workspace stays pending until U6.
Only for the account with the invitation's address. Joins the workspace with the invitation's role, or keeps the role of an existing member.

patch.description: Changes only the fields sent. lastWorkspaceId must be one of the caller's workspaces.

put.description: multipart/form-data with the photo as file: a JPEG, PNG or WebP image of at most 5 MB, told by its content. Stored as a 512×512 WebP.

post.description: Confirms with the address, and the password or a sign-in within the last 10 minutes. Refuses with LAST_OWNER while the caller is the only Owner of a workspace with other members.
For an account that signed up with Google only, within 10 minutes of signing in. Ends every other session.
The caller becomes its Owner and lands on it. The currency defaults to PHP.

patch.summary: W1 Change a workspace's name or currency
patch.description: Owner only. Amounts are not converted.

get.summary: W2 The members of a workspace
get.description: In the order they joined. Only an Owner gets the addresses.

patch.description: Owner only. Becoming a Viewer ends the member's self-analysis share here and names them in free text on their execution items.

delete.summary: W3 Remove a member, or leave
delete.description: An Owner removes anyone; every member may leave with userId me. Ends the member's self-analysis share here and names them in free text on their execution items.

get.summary: W8 Whom a comment may mention
get.description: Every member, Viewers included. On a self-analysis answer (targetKey is its question), only the Owners and Members of a workspace it is shared with, and Viewers may not ask.

get.summary: W4 The invitations of a workspace
get.description: Owner only, newest first. status=pending (the default) lists those that can still be accepted; all adds accepted, revoked and expired ones.

post.summary: W4 Invite someone to a workspace
post.description: Owner only. Mails the link to the address and never returns it. 503 UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE when the mail cannot be sent, and then no invitation is made.

An Owner of the invitation's workspace, or an operator for any invitation. Makes a new link, ending the old one, and a new expiry. Expired invitations may be resent. Refuses with ALREADY_MEMBER and INVITATION_PENDING as W4 does.

delete.description: An Owner of the invitation's workspace, or an operator for any invitation.

get.summary: D1 The ideas of the dashboard
get.description: Not archived and not Drop, by latest activity. droppedCount counts the Drop ideas not archived.
Owners and Members by name. How far a self-analysis is shows only when it is shared with this workspace.
Not Done or Resolved, overdue or due within 7 days of today in the caller's time zone, outside archived ideas and plans. The caller's own first, then by due date.

The latest 20 changes, comments and decision log entries, newest first. An operation over many items is one move, and saves of one item by one person within 10 minutes of each other are one, at the last. Nothing about self-analyses.

get.summary: I1 The ideas of a workspace
get.description: Drop ideas are hidden by default (decision=not_dropped) and counted in hiddenDroppedCount. q matches the name or the one-line concept, ignoring case.

post.description: Makes its validation on the latest published validation template, with the template's cost rows Empty. 409 TEMPLATE_NOT_PUBLISHED before an operator has published one.

patch.description: Name, one-line concept and proposed solution, under the optimistic lock: 409 CONFLICT with the stored overview when lockVersion is stale, unless force.

post.description: Copies the validation's content into a new, undecided idea proposed by the caller, archived or Drop ideas included. batchId undoes the copy through H3.
Hides it from lists and the dashboard and makes it read-only. Writes no history and keeps updatedAt.

get.summary: V1 The validation hub of an idea (13)
get.description: Checks, Next steps, the F/A/U breakdown and key metrics are calculated by packages/domain. Links a caller cannot enter (a Viewer's 19 and new research log entries, an archived idea's) are null.

get.summary: V2 The questions of a section (11)
get.description: sectionKey is 01, 02 or 10. One answer per question, unanswered and hidden ones included.

put.summary: V3 Save an answer and its F/A/U
put.description: Creates the answer at version 1 on its first save. Clearing the text clears F/A/U except Unknown. A Fact needs active evidence (V4 setFact), an Assumption a confidence.

post.description: One of researchLogEntryId, newResearchLog or url. lockVersion is the item's; attaching raises it. setFact makes an item with a value a Fact. Competitors and assumptions take evidence without F/A/U.

delete.description: lockVersion is the version of the item the evidence is on; removing raises it. Removing a Fact's last counting evidence makes it Unclassified.

get.description: The newest observation first, entries without a date last, then the newest recorded. supports and sourceType filter; q matches the topic or the observation, ignoring case.

post.summary: V6 Record a research log entry (14)
post.description: observedOn left out is saved as no date: the form fills in today. Blank optional texts are saved as null.

get.summary: V7 A research log entry and where it is evidence (14)
get.description: usages lists the items shown that cite it, in the order the evidence was attached: what 14 shows and what deleting it would leave a Fact without evidence. hiddenUsageCount counts the answers a template migration hid that cite it, which the deletion's confirmation mentions by number. A deleted entry is 404.

patch.summary: V7 Edit a research log entry (14)
patch.description: Only the fields sent change, under the optimistic lock: 409 CONFLICT with the stored entry when lockVersion is stale, unless force.

delete.summary: V7 Delete a research log entry (14)
delete.description: Deletes it logically. The evidence that cites it stays attached but no longer counts: a Fact it was the only evidence of becomes Fact · No evidence. affected and hiddenAffectedCount are what V7 GET's usages and hiddenUsageCount were.

get.description: items in their order; patterns are V.04.SURVIVOR_PATTERNS and V.04.FAILURE_PATTERNS with their answers (saved through V3); guidance is the check's 3–5.

post.description: Added at the end of the list.

patch.description: Only the fields sent change, under the optimistic lock: 409 CONFLICT with the stored row when lockVersion is stale, unless force.

delete.description: Deletes it logically, its comments with it; the history can restore it.

post.description: Added at the end of the list.

get.description: Rows put in order by hand first, then the others by Impact and Probability, highest first (a level not set ranks below Low), ties in the order they were made.

post.description: At the end of a list put in order by hand; otherwise in the automatic order, with sortOrder null.

patch.description: Only the fields sent change, under the optimistic lock: 409 CONFLICT with the stored row when lockVersion is stale, unless force.

delete.description: Deletes it logically, its comments with it; the history can restore it.

patch.description: Only the fields sent change, under the optimistic lock: 409 CONFLICT with the stored row when lockVersion is stale, unless force.

delete.description: Deletes it logically, its comments with it; the history can restore it.

ids are every row of the list not deleted (of the table named by category, for cost rows), in the new order. Writes no history and changes no version. Risks keep the order by hand from then on.

get.description: Rows by table (startup, monthly fixed, variable), each in its order. result holds the Totals and the break-even of 18; economicsInputs are all seven numbers, for calculating again while typing.

post.description: An Empty row at the end of its table; + Add row sends an empty name.

patch.description: Only the fields sent change, under the optimistic lock: a stale lockVersion is 409 CONFLICT before any 422 that depends on the stored row. A percentage of the price is for variable rows (PERCENT_ONLY_FOR_VARIABLE); a value of the input mode not in use is VALIDATION_FAILED; amounts and rates out of their rule are OUT_OF_RANGE. Unknown clears the value, and a value typed into an Unknown row makes it Unclassified; a value sent with Unknown is VALIDATION_FAILED. F/A/U otherwise as V3.

delete.description: Deletes it logically, template rows included; the history can restore it.

get.description: inputs are all seven numbers, unsaved ones empty at version 0. worth is V.08.WORTH (saved through V3), hidden when the pinned version lacks it; worthQuestion is its question of the pinned version, null then. result is calculated by packages/domain.

put.summary: V16 Save a number of 18 and its F/A/U
put.description: Creates the number at version 1 on its first save. A value out of the field's rule (design-spec 6.0.8) is OUT_OF_RANGE. Unknown clears the value; a value typed into an Unknown number makes it Unclassified; a value sent with Unknown is VALIDATION_FAILED. A request that changes neither value nor F/A/U writes nothing.

get.summary: V18 What a decision is recorded on (19)
get.description: The summary, key numbers, the checks not done, the F/A/U breakdown and the latest decision.

post.description: Adds a decision log entry with a snapshot of the checks not done, the key metrics and the F/A/U breakdown, changes the idea's latest decision and notifies the workspace. 409 DECISION_CHANGED with the latest decision when one was recorded after basedOnDecisionId, unless confirmNewer.

get.description: The first call makes it on the latest published version, not started. Operators too.

patch.summary: S1 PATCH Change the currency of the caller's self-analysis
patch.description: Amounts keep their numbers: nothing is converted.

get.summary: S2 A section of the caller's self-analysis (11)
get.description: One answer per question, unanswered ones included, with its comment count in each workspace it is shared with.

put.summary: S3 Save an answer of the caller's self-analysis
put.description: Creates the answer at version 1 on its first save, and the first answer that counts as answered (a question its display condition hides counts nowhere) makes the self-analysis in progress. Only amount-with-reason questions take an amount.

post.summary: S4 Mark the caller's self-analysis as done
post.description: With empty questions, 409 HAS_EMPTY_QUESTIONS (emptyCount) unless confirmEmpty is true. A done one stays as it is.
Back to in progress; its shares stay. One that is not done stays as it is.

put.summary: S5 Set the workspaces the caller's self-analysis is shared with (M6)
put.description: The whole set. Adding needs it done (MUST_BE_DONE_TO_SHARE); removing works any time. Only team workspaces the caller is an Owner or Member of (NOT_SHAREABLE).

get.description: Owners and Members by name. How far a self-analysis is shows only when it is shared with this workspace.

get.summary: S7 A member's self-analysis shared with the workspace (12)
get.description: Read only, with comment counts in this workspace and no history. 403 NOT_SHARED unless shared with this workspace.

get.summary: P1 The plans of an idea
get.description: In the order they were made. Archived plans only with includeArchived=true.

post.description: On the latest published plan template: the validation's answers copied where the template says, and its starting execution rows, as one plan_draft operation H3 can undo. 409 DECISION_NOT_PROCEED unless the latest decision is Proceed, TEMPLATE_NOT_PUBLISHED, NAME_TAKEN (archived plans count).

get.description: With versionId, the items' progress, key metrics, Business Name and Prepared By come from that saved version; draftOnly and the execution counts stay the plan's now.

patch.description: The plan's name, Business Name and Prepared By, under the optimistic lock (409 CONFLICT unless force). 409 NAME_TAKEN when another plan of the idea has the name.

post.description: Read only afterwards, and out of the stage, Due soon and the plans 13 lists. Writes no history and keeps updatedAt.

get.summary: P6 The saved versions of a plan, newest first

post.description: Keeps a read-only snapshot of the plan (SDD 6.3), records version_saved in the decision log and notifies the workspace.

get.summary: P7 What a Go / No-Go is recorded on (M4)
get.description: The §24 conditions, the validation's key metrics, the latest saved version and whether the plan changed since, and the plan's Go / No-Go history.

post.description: On the latest saved version (none when no version is saved), with the §24 conditions and the validation's key metrics. Notifies the workspace. A Launch makes the idea's stage launch_prep.

get.description: itemNo is 1–30. With versionId, the answers, numbers and execution items are that saved version's; the references are always the validation's now. The shared self-analyses only for Owners and Members.

put.description: text for a text or choice sub-item, rows for a table, created at version 1 on its first save. 422 NOT_EDITABLE for number and execution sub-items, QUESTION_NOT_FOUND, INVALID_CHOICE. A cell longer than its limit is accepted only while it keeps a value the table holds already (a draft's copy).

get.summary: P9 The execution items of a plan (22)
get.description: By type; Next Actions by due date (none last), the others in their order (P11). assignee is me or a user's id.

post.description: At the end of its type. A column the type lacks is 422 VALIDATION_FAILED (dueDate on a KPI too), a status it does not take 422 INVALID_STATUS, an assignee who is not an Owner or Member 422 INVALID_ASSIGNEE. A launch item goes to Other unless launchTiming says otherwise.

patch.description: Under the optimistic lock. Done or Resolved stamps completedAt, a new kpiActual stamps kpiActualUpdatedAt. Naming a member or a name as the assignee clears the other.

delete.description: Deletes it logically, without the lock; the history can restore it.

put.summary: P11 Order the execution items of a type
put.description: ids is every item of the type not deleted, in the new order. Next Actions go by their due date: 422 for next_action.

get.description: The one-minute (8) or five-minute (12) slides from the plan now, or from the saved version versionId, fitted to the slide: font sizes down by shrink steps, then texts cut with an ellipsis (overflow). Edit source links only for Owners and Members on the plan now, neither plan nor idea archived.

get.summary: P13 The Pitch Deck as a PDF
get.description: The slides of P12 on landscape pages, always light, with the Business Name, the version (or Draft) and the date at the foot of each; the speaker notes stay out. 30 per user per hour (429 RATE_LIMITED).

The caller's self-analysis (no id), or the validation or plan id, archived ones included. sections (self-analysis, validation), items or part (plan) narrow the scope; without them it is the whole. Hidden questions and those an import cannot write are left out. Nothing is recorded. Counted with X3, 60 per user per hour (429 RATE_LIMITED); refusals before the export are not counted.
The template's sections and questions with the answers they hold now and their versions. Archived ideas and plans are read too (target.archived). Not counted.

post.description: All the changes in one transaction, or none. 409 CONFLICT_MULTI (error.conflicts) when an answer that changes was saved since baseLockVersion; 422 NOT_IMPORTABLE for tables, numbers, execution items and hidden questions, QUESTION_NOT_FOUND, VALIDATION_FAILED for a value that does not fit or a question twice. A validation answer whose text changes becomes Unclassified unless classification is sent. History ai_import under one batchId. Counted with X1, 60 per user per hour (429 RATE_LIMITED); a refused import is not counted.

get.description: Decisions, Go / No-Go and saved versions of the workspace, newest first, archived ideas and plans included. from and to are dates in the caller's time zone, both included.
The entry with what it kept of the moment it was recorded: the checks not done, the key metrics, the F/A/U breakdown, a Go / No-Go's conditions and the plan version.

get.summary: C1 The comments on an item or a screen (PNL-1)
get.description: One item (targetType, targetId, targetKey), or one screen (containerType, containerId, sectionKeys) with, inside an idea, the comments on the idea. Threads oldest first, deleted comments as deleted without their body. Comments on deleted rows and on questions a migration hid are not returned. A self-analysis's owner reads the comments of every workspace it is shared with now; its Owners and Members read those of workspaceId (Viewers 403 FORBIDDEN, 403 NOT_SHARED).

post.description: A new thread, or a reply to the first comment of one (422 REPLY_DEPTH). Everyone in the workspace may comment, Viewers too; on a self-analysis only Owners and Members of a workspace it is shared with (403 FORBIDDEN, 403 NOT_SHARED). Mentions are people W8 offers (422 INVALID_MENTION). Notifies the mentioned, the idea's proposer, the plan's maker, the self-analysis's owner and the thread's writers once each. 409 ARCHIVED on archived content.

patch.description: Its writer only (403 FORBIDDEN). Replaces the body and the mentions; only the newly mentioned are notified. 409 ARCHIVED on archived content.

delete.description: Its writer only (403 FORBIDDEN). The comment stays in its thread as deleted, without its body; deleting it again changes nothing. 409 ARCHIVED on archived content.

post.description: On the first comment of the thread (422 VALIDATION_FAILED on a reply). Anyone who may comment on the item; Viewers not on a self-analysis. 409 ARCHIVED on archived content.

delete.description: On the first comment of the thread (422 VALIDATION_FAILED on a reply). Anyone who may comment on the item; Viewers not on a self-analysis. 409 ARCHIVED on archived content.

get.summary: H1 The history of an item or a screen (PNL-2)
get.description: One item (targetType, targetId, targetKey), deleted rows included, or one screen (containerType, containerId, sectionKeys), newest first. The idea's screen (13) adds the template migrations of its validation and the undone creations. A self-analysis's history is its owner's only (403 FORBIDDEN).

post.summary: H2 Revert an item to just after a change (PNL-2)
post.description: Puts the item's text, numbers, F/A/U, confidence and evidence as the change left them; a deletion is undone. No version is compared. Writes a revert row, or nothing (entry null) when the item already is so. 422 VALIDATION_FAILED for a template migration (H3 undoes it) and for an undone creation; 409 NAME_TAKEN when a plan's old name is taken now. A self-analysis is its owner's only.

post.summary: H3 Undo a whole operation (PNL-2, M8)
post.description: An AI import, a template migration or a revert: every item back to what the operation found, as one revert operation (batchId; H3 can undo it in turn). 409 ALREADY_REVERTED until that revert is itself undone. A duplicate or a plan draft is not reverted but removed (undoing a creation): 409 UNDO_BLOCKED when anything was added since, 409 BUSY when another write holds it, 409 ALREADY_REVERTED the second time; reverted counts the operation's rows and batchId is its own.

get.description: Across workspaces, newest first; filter=unread for the unread only. accessible is false once the caller left the workspace or can no longer read the item; such a notification says only who did what, without the place or the excerpt.

get.summary: N2 How many notifications are unread
get.description: For the badge of the navigation. The client asks when a screen opens, when the app comes to the front and every 60 seconds.

post.summary: N3 Mark a notification as read (8)
post.description: The caller's own only; another person's is 404 NOT_FOUND. Reading it again changes nothing.

get.description: Better Auth decides the paths, bodies and answers (SDD 5.4). Errors come in its { code, message } shape (SDD 8.1).

post.description: Better Auth decides the paths, bodies and answers (SDD 5.4). Errors come in its { code, message } shape (SDD 8.1).
